title: Tula sees record sales in April even as coronavirus ravages retail
主要内容: Tula, a New York-based skincare company, reported record sales in April 2020, despite the challenges posed by the coronavirus pandemic. The company saw a 400% increase in sales compared to the previous year, marking its best April in six years. This growth was attributed to the rising demand for clean beauty products, which are free of toxic chemicals and undesirable ingredients like sulfates and parabens. Tula's CEO, Savannah Sachs, noted that consumers are increasingly investing in health and wellness while staying at home. The company's success is also linked to its direct-to-consumer (DTC) model and its focus on health-centered ingredients such as superfoods and probiotics. According to NPD, the natural beauty segment, including skincare, saw an 11% increase in sales, while prestige beauty sales dropped 14% in 2020. This trend highlights the growing importance of clean beauty in the market. Tula, a clean beauty brand, reported record sales in April despite the challenges posed by the coronavirus pandemic. The company's success is attributed to its strong social media presence and influencer partnerships. While Tula's sales grew significantly, it faced supply chain disruptions due to strict social distancing measures and reduced employee capacity in U.S. warehouses, leading to longer order processing times. The company's CEO, Sachs, emphasized the importance of transparent communication with customers during these disruptions. Tula also lost some exposure through its wholesale partnerships with retailers like Ulta and Nordstrom, which temporarily shut their doors. However, its strong ties to the influencer community helped it recover lost ground. Influencers with follower counts ranging from 2,000 to over 100,000 helped drive traffic and raise brand awareness. According to a 2019 survey by Euromonitor, 80% of respondents believe health-inspired beauty trends will influence sales in the next five years, highlighting the growing importance of clean beauty in the market.
